about: Lists that cover all of New Jersey, shared by every office in or near New Jersey (Elder Bendio, 13 October 2026: share state and federal lists between Scout runs). First found by Bridgeport's lists search of 13 October 2026; an office's own file names these by URL rather than repeating them.

lists.title: NJ Office of the Attorney General: Office of Hope and Healing / NJCARES resource book (Dec 2022)

notes.addiction: county-by-county substance-use contacts including Gloucester, Salem, Camden; 14 MB PDF, Dec 2022; numbers may have changed

lists.title: NJ Dental Clinic Directory 2026 (NJ Dept of Health, Oral Health Services Unit)

notes.medical-dental-vision: 48-page statewide directory by county, 2026; public dental clinics (health departments, hospitals, FQHCs) with hours, ages and payment (sliding scale); Gloucester section names 2 clinics (Complete Care Health Network, Glassboro; CamCare, Paulsboro); Camden and Salem have more; no vision

lists.residency: Some clinics limit by county of residence, e.g. Complete Care Health Network limited to Cape May, Cumberland and Gloucester residents (the directory's own NOTE)

lists.title: Rowan University: Legal and Immigration Resources

notes.legal: university list naming Southern New Jersey Legal Services, Rutgers Law Camden Domestic Violence Law Clinic, American Hispanic Immigration Organization (Newark); about 3 providers; undated; from search summary [404 or rejected on 13 Oct; known only from search results]

lists.title: NJ DCA: LIHEAP agencies list (by county)

notes.utilities-phone-internet: state list of the LIHEAP application agency in each county; Gloucester is served by Gateway Community Action Partnership; not opened, from search listing

lists.title: NJ Reentry Corporation: NJ Support Resources Directory

notes.reentry-support: statewide directory in nine sections (hotlines, addiction and violence, benefits, cash and food, housing, employment and reentry, 13 free-legal organisations, victims and veterans, county tables of social services and one-stop career centres); no date on the page; curl got 403 so it was read through WebFetch's summary only; county tables name 2 entries for Gloucester, 3 for Camden, 2 for Salem (summary count, unverified)

lists.title: NJ Division of Family Development: County Welfare Agencies (Boards of Social Services)

notes.financial-assistance: state list of each county's Board of Social Services (Gloucester Division of Social Services, Camden, Salem); page says 'Updated 07/17/19'

lists.title: NJ Department of Health: Federally Qualified Health Centers (search by county, map)

notes.medical-dental-vision: state FQHC search by county, city or name, plus map and an administrative contacts PDF; last reviewed 3/13/2025; names no centers on the page

lists.byLocation: Search by county or city; not run (page read; search is on an external page)

lists.title: NJ DOC: Federally Qualified Health Centers NJ 2026 (attachment to reentry packet)

notes.medical-dental-vision: 2026 FQHC list prepared for NJ DOC reentry packets; from search listing, not opened

lists.title: Legal Services of New Jersey: LSNJLAW (statewide hotline 1-888-576-5529, self-help, resource directories)

notes.legal: statewide coordinating office of the six legal-services programmes; hotline hours Mon-Fri 8-5:30 per the site (search summary); topic pages for housing, jobs, government aid, utilities; South Jersey Legal Services covers Gloucester, Camden, Salem

lists.residency: Low-income New Jersey residents (financial eligibility), civil matters only

lists.title: NJ 211 (statewide; administered by United Ways of New Jersey; also runs the state homeless and energy-assistance hotlines)

notes.food: statewide referral database; the United Ways page says over 1,000,000 requests a year; individual provider pages at search.nj211.org are readable and several were seen (Gloucester pantries, legal aid, LIHEAP, veterans); the search itself is a form

lists.byLocation: Search by ZIP or county at search.nj211.org; call 2-1-1 or text 898-211; the search form was not run

lists.title: NJ DCF: community support contacts (Oct 2025)

notes.children-pregnancy: state children-and-families contact sheet dated 10/2025 by its filename; from search listing, not opened [404 or rejected on 13 Oct; known only from search results]

lists.title: NJ Motor Vehicle Commission FAQ (IDs, non-driver ID)

notes.id-recovery: state agency page, a how-to rather than a list; a law (S-2350/S-2351 per a sponsors' press release, unchecked) waives MVC fees for a non-driver ID and a birth certificate for homeless residents with a social worker's letter

lists.title: US Courts (E.D. Pa. probation): GED list for NJ

notes.education: court probation office's list of New Jersey GED classes; undated; from search listing, not opened [404 or rejected on 13 Oct; known only from search results]

lists.title: Rutgers Cooperative Extension Food Waste Team: NJ Food Pantry List (county directories)

notes.food: hub page that links the county food guides (Gloucester, Camden, Salem among 20+); compiled in Oct 2025 during the SNAP lapse; also donations and clothing links

lists.title: NJ Basic Needs Information Hub (Office of the Secretary of Higher Education; open to all residents)

notes.food: state hub for students and residents linking State programmes and community services; includes a page on essential items (diapers) that says to call 211; not a provider list

lists.title: NJ DMAVA veterans service offices (older PDF with Camden/Gloucester Woodbury Armory entry)

notes.veterans: older state PDF used by Parole; lists Camden/Gloucester office at the Woodbury Armory; probably superseded by the newer Camden office

lists.title: NJ DMHAS: Directory of Mental Health Services (DMHAS-contracted providers only), updated April 2026

notes.mental-health: statewide PDF by county, 'Updated April 2026' on the cover; contracted providers only; Gloucester, Camden and Salem sections not tallied

lists.title: NJ 211: phone and internet assistance programmes (Lifeline etc.)

notes.utilities-phone-internet: statewide page describing the federal Lifeline free-phone programme and providers; no local list; the NJ Basic Needs hub (nj.gov/basicneeds/technology/internet-access.shtml) says ACP may have ended

lists.title: NJ Board of Public Utilities: residential assistance (Lifeline utility benefit, Winter Termination Program 1-800-624-0241)

notes.utilities-phone-internet: state page of utility-bill assistance programmes; short page; names programmes not local providers

lists.title: NJ 211: New Jersey Code Blue (county warming centres and activations)

notes.homeless-services: statewide Code Blue listing by county, changes with the weather; the county OEM is the source; Salem County has a Code Blue warming centre per the IAC guide

lists.title: NJ State Library: Get Help, New Jersey Social Services (research guide with county tabs for Camden, Gloucester, Salem)

notes.housing: state library guide with topic pages (employment, housing, literacy, reentry) and a county tab for each of Camden, Gloucester and Salem linking each county's social-services pages; page read; the county tabs link to pages already recorded
